description: Object-relational mapper: maps tables to models and relations to properties (Prisma, TypeORM, MikroORM).
A typed API that composes SQL step by step (Kysely, Knex, Drizzle core); the SQL stays predictable.
A versioned, ordered script that changes the schema; applied migrations are recorded in a table.
Zero-downtime schema change in steps: add the new shape, migrate data and code, then remove the old shape in a later release.
The real database differs from what migrations describe, usually after manual changes or `db push`.
Postgres option that builds an index without blocking writes; required for large production tables.
